question_summary: Contractor requests approval to substitute a tankless water heater for the specified storage-type unit in Section 22 34 00 prior to ordering material and beginning fixture rough-in.
proposed_solution: Use a tankless water heater alternate in lieu of the specified storage-type unit.
deadline_text: Please respond by the end of the week
routing_rationale: As a cost-neutral substitution request within the Plumbing discipline, it is routed to the Plumbing/Fire Protection Engineer as the design professional of record for review and approval.
